# Five Wish Trees Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** Execute the approved design with isolated file ownership using available collaboration tools; optional superpowers subagent workflow is unavailable. No repeat approval.

**Goal:** Show five configured wish-tree skins with consistent chop alignment and restrained original-art light.

**Architecture:** A dedicated import script normalizes original sprites and optional original-pixel highlight layers. Existing tree appearance/rendering uses five descriptors; current config remains generated by sync-config.py.

**Tech Stack:** Vanilla JS/CSS, Pillow, Feishu CLI, Node/Python tests, mocked Playwright.

## Constraints

- Preserve source/old art, unrelated supabase directory, gameplay amounts, delays, data and audio.
- Do not create large new glow shapes; keep any highlight anchored to original bright art.
- No screenshots or real player writes. User authorized configuration sync and release.

## Task 1: Assets (effect_audit)

Files: scripts/import_wish_trees.py, assets/images/wish-trees/*, assets/runtime/wish-trees/*, tests/wish-tree-assets.test.py, docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md.

- [x] Measure actual RGBA, five cells and alpha edges; report source ground/strike/crown anchors before integration.
- [x] Normalize five sprites by uniform scale/translation around lower trunk strike and ground baseline, retaining all artwork and safety margins. Use one common canvas and document actual anchors. Never trim solely by crown bounds. Runtime target384px square unless measured artwork requires other uniform ratio.
- [x] Output tree_01.webp through tree_05.webp, source PNGs and manifests. If useful, extract light-01.webp through light-05.webp from existing luminous pixels only, with the exact same canvas/anchors; no painted blur circles.
- [x] Add deterministic --check, source fingerprint, boundary/anchor/alpha/count/byte tests. Retain original and old assets. Communicate paths, normalized strike/ground, ratios and total bytes.

## Task 2: Configuration (login_motion)

Files: game-config.js via sync-config.py only; sync-config.py only if truly required for supported validation; no other edits.

- [x] Use configured Feishu CLI safely, inspect actual tree_appearance column and English header; no unnecessary edits or reauthorization.
- [x] Run existing sync pipeline, review semantic diff against HEAD. Preserve user table values, report appearance-to-realm mapping and any unrelated source changes before release.
- [x] Bound failed external calls; if sync fails, diagnose actual CLI/account issue, do not guess config values. Do not output credentials or modify player data.

## Task 3: Runtime (Root)

Files: app.js, styles.css, cultivation-effects.js if anchor forwarding is needed, index.html, relevant Node tests, PROJECT_PLAYBOOK.

- [x] Extend appearance descriptors to tree_01..05, aliases for historical keys, default tree_01. Use measured common anchors and preload matching versioned URLs.
- [x] Align all five skins with existing character strike and ground, keep tree z-index below character and overlays pointer-events none. Update tree detail to current skin.
- [x] Add at most one original-art light overlay per tree, opacity-only slow 7–9s low amplitude, no whole-sprite filter or geometry. Reduced motion/static-hidden rules prevent ongoing decorative work offscreen.
- [x] Pass normalized strike/crown metadata into existing hit effects while preserving legacy fallback, durations, sound and leaf count. Update changed cache URLs only.
- [x] Update focused tests for five mappings, exact preloads, stable anchors, motion accessibility and unchanged existing gameplay; document final measured rules.
